run_conan_multipackager_build: run the ConanMultiPackager builder to build and upload the uvw C++ library package
get_version_from_cmake: get the uvw library version by parsing the CMakeLists.txt file or GITHUB_REF environment variable
get_conan_reference: get the Conan package reference string in the format uvw/version@username/stable
get_bintray_upload_url: get the Bintray API upload URL for the Conan package repository
check_upload_when_stable: check if packages should only be uploaded when on a stable version branch
